routes.reviewNote: The Solana YLDS deployment is Hastra wYLDS — a wrapped token backed 1:1 by YLDS from Hastra, the liquidity protocol incubated by Figure and Provenance Blockchain, with cross-chain interoperability on Chainlink CCIP (Figure press release 2025-12-04). The verified mint-authority review (2026-07-15) identifies the Solana direct mint authority EOA AJuGsS1NrHgxpHgUu7AgCvshFGL8WdRwxks9sfAVhNQM as the mint control on this deployment.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: YLDS is issued by Figure Certificate Company on Provenance as the uylds.fcc marker (verified mint-authority review 2026-07-15: 4-of-6 marker admin and mint policy plus individual mint authorities).

The Ethereum YLDS-tracked token is 'Hastra wYLDS' (name/symbol verified 2026-07-19), an ERC1967 proxy wrapped token backed 1:1 by YLDS from Hastra — the Figure/Provenance-incubated liquidity protocol — with cross-chain interoperability on Chainlink CCIP. Its DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is the 4-of-7 Gnosis Safe 0x8d358b8ae881f8ea92c3d07783abca21727c6309 (owners read on-chain; original deploy admin fully revoked by block 25032014). DefiLlama counts the Ethereum supply as bridged-from-provenance. Figure's legal disclaimer notes Figure does not itself issue wYLDS.
